# Vendored test batteries

The sources `build.sh` builds, so that the benchmark does not download them.

- `TestU01/`: TestU01 1.2.3 by Pierre L'Ecuyer and Richard Simard, from the
  authors' repository <https://github.com/umontreal-simul/TestU01-2009>,
  commit `57e98bf33880daedc930739c81e39b89a8d24dba`, unmodified. Apache
  License 2.0, see `TestU01/LICENSE`.
- `PractRand/`: PractRand pre-0.95 by Chris Doty-Humphrey, the `include/`,
  `src/` and `tools/` directories of
  <https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/pracrand/PractRand-pre0.95.zip>,
  unmodified. Public domain, as its SourceForge project page states; see
  `PractRand/LICENSE`, which is not part of the archive.
